# Co-COO Aviva Will on the growth of legal finance in The American Lawyer


February 8, 2024


-
-
-
-


*The American Lawyer* quotes Burford Co-COO[Aviva Will](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/aviva-will/) from a recent Burford[webcast](https://www.burfordcapital.com/insights-news-events/events-webcasts/a-conversation-with-brad-hildebrandt-achieving-law-firm-growth-in-uncertain-times/) , on how "big law and litigation finance seem to be having a moment," and how Will has seen "'a recent uptick in interest from companies and large law firms.'"
